title: Why Drainage Vents Cause Gurgling Pipes
description: When fixtures gurgle or drain slowly, the problem often isn't inside the drain pipe itself, but above it in the venting system. A plumbing vent regulates pressure within the drainage network, allowing air to displace wastewater. If bird nests, leaves, or debris block the roof vent stack, flowing water creates a negative pressure siphon. This vacuum pulls air through adjacent fixture traps, sucking out their water seals and producing distinct gurgling sounds. Clearing vent obstructions restores balanced atmospheric pressure, ensuring smooth gravity drainage and protecting water seals that keep sewer gases out of living spaces.
